title: Shramyogi Home Town Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board

scheme.name: Shramyogi Home Town Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
scheme.summary: The scheme facilitates the payment of railway fares for migrant labourers employed in the organized sector in Gujarat to travel to or from their home country to the nearest railway station.
eligibility: The worker/labour should have been working continuously with the company in Gujarat for one year and his/her labour welfare fund should have been deposited in the board.
The benefit is provided once within a block of two years (2022-23 and 2023-24).
If both husband and wife are employed, only one beneficiary will get the benefit.
A Shram Yogi shall travel only after obtaining prior approval by applying prior to travel.
scheme.benefits: Migrant laborers employed in the organized sector can avail payment for railway fare to travel to or from their home country to the nearest railway station, credited via DBT.
documents: A copy of the identity card issued by the contractor to the worker/labour
Valid proof of travel to hometown
